basic_info.description: Welcome to your next home: a sleek 2-bed, 2-bath condo in the heart of Presidio and Pacific Heights. This 964 sq ft unit features a $40K fully renovated bathroom, two custom closets, and bonus storage. Just steps from the Presidio, JCC gym, Fillmore cafes, Clement farmers market, and top restaurants like Spruce and Sociale. Ideal for professionals seeking style, convenience, and luxury without compromise. Everything you desire is within easy reach. Don't miss the opportunity to create your dream home in Pacific Heights, one of San Francisco's most iconic and prestigious neighborhoods.
